summary: ITU-T G.709 introduced new ODU containers (ODU0, ODU4, ODU2e, and ODUflex) and more flexibility. This document updates the ODU-related parts of RFC 4328 with GMPLS signaling extensions to control the full set of OTN features.

eli5.summary: Optical networks have new sizes of shipping containers. This teaches the signaling system how to ask for each size when setting up a path.
